propositions: On the agentic execution path, the growing tool-result message history is re-sent uncached every turn, causing O(N^2) input token cost growth across turns.

The current cache_settings_for implementation sets only two of four available breakpoints (anthropic_cache_instructions and anthropic_cache_tool_definitions) but neither anthropic_cache nor anthropic_cache_messages is enabled for message tail caching.
The telemetry predicate warn_if_cache_ineffective cannot detect this inefficiency because the system block hits cache, making cache_read_tokens nonzero and preventing the alert from firing.

Anthropic and Bedrock have asymmetric cache control APIs: Anthropic uses anthropic_cache for automatic multi-message caching while Bedrock uses bedrock_cache_messages but rejects a top-level cache_control key.
Single-turn paths must remain byte-identical to avoid regression, requiring execution_mode to be threaded into cache_settings_for to conditionally enable message caching only on agentic mode.
